places.name: Khayelitsha
places.population_note: One of Cape Town's largest township areas — exact ward rollup pending Census SA1 join.
places.summary: Khayelitsha sits on the Cape Flats growth edge. MyCiTi Cape Flats expansion is funded in the 2026/27 MTREF (R3.2–R3.3bn; Mitchells Plain / Khayelitsha named). City of Hope R40bn infrastructure is protected for 2026/27–2028/29. Safety budget R6.8bn (2026/27). Helm does not yet hold Khayelitsha-only clinic, EMS, or SAPS precinct time series.
themes: MyCiTi Mitchells Plain / Khayelitsha corridor — R3.2–R3.3bn in 2026/27 MTREF
City of Hope infrastructure — R40bn over 2026/27–2028/29 (Council adopted 29 Jun 2026)
Safety & LEAP capacity — R6.8bn safety budget 2026/27; LEAP murder −3.7% Q3 2025/26 (verify SAPS)
